drawings.name: PbkFromMono
drawings.rocqProof:
Lemma PbkFromMono_rule : forall (a a_2 a_3 d : Vertex)(e1 : Edge a a_2)(eq_a_a_a : a = a_3)(eq_a_a_a_2 : a_3 = a_2), ltac:(subst_all_in (forall (e2 : Edge a a_3)(f1 : Edge a_2 d)(f2 : Edge a_3 d)(isId_2 : isId e1)(isId_3 : isId e2)(isMono_2 : isMono f1)(isMono_3 : isMono f2)(eq_f1_f2 : f1 = f2), ltac:(subst_all_in (Pullback e1 e2 f2 f1)))).
intros_sigma ().
assert (Hpremise1 : Square e1 e2 f2 f1). {
  intros_sigma ().
  destruct_sigma (@IdLeftComp_rule a a_2 d e1 eq_refl f1 isId_2) as f Triangle_2 eq_f1_f2_f.
  destruct_sigma (@IdLeft_rule a a_3 d e2 eq_refl f2 f isId_3 eq_refl) as Triangle_3.
  destruct_sigma (@Square_rule a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f2 f1 f Triangle_2 Triangle_3) as Square_3.
  exact Square_3.
}
assert (Hpremise2 : forall (x : Vertex)(Edge_2 : Edge x a_3)(Edge_3 : Edge x a_2)(Square_2 : Square Edge_3 Edge_2 f2 f1), Σ (Edge_4 : Edge x a)(Triangle_2 : Triangle Edge_4 e2 Edge_2), Triangle Edge_4 e1 Edge_3). {
  intros_sigma ().
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp2_rule x a a_3 e2 Edge_2 eq_refl isId_3) as f Triangle_4 eq_f_Edge.
  destruct_sigma (@Square___Def__reverse__rule x a_2 a_3 d Edge_3 Edge_2 f1 f2 Square_2) as Edge_5 Triangle_5 Triangle_6.
  destruct_sigma (@Mono2___Premise__reverse__rule a d x f1 Edge_2 Edge_3 Edge_5 isMono_2 Triangle_6 Triangle_5) as eq_f_Edge_Edge.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRight_rule x a a_2 f e1 Edge_3 eq_refl isId_2 eq_refl) as Triangle_7.
  exact (Edge_2, Triangle_4, Triangle_7).
}
assert (Hpremise3 : forall (y : Vertex)(Edge_2 : Edge y a_3)(Edge_3 : Edge y a_2)(i j : Edge y a)(iu : Triangle i e2 Edge_2)(xif : Triangle i e1 Edge_3)(ju : Triangle j e2 Edge_2)(jf : Triangle j e1 Edge_3), i = j). {
  intros_sigma ().
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule y a a_2 i e1 eq_refl isId_2) as f Triangle_2 eq_i_f.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule y a a_2 j e1 eq_refl isId_2) as f_2 Triangle_3 eq_j_f.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule y a a_2 i e1 Edge_3 f xif Triangle_2) as eq_i_f_Edge eq_xif_Triangle.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule y a a_2 j e1 Edge_3 f_2 jf Triangle_3) as eq_j_f_i_f_Edge eq_jf_Triangle.
  exact eq_refl.
}
destruct_sigma (@Pullback_rule a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f2 f1 Hpremise1 Hpremise2 Hpremise3) as Pullback_3.
exact Pullback_3.
Qed.
drawings.abellaProof:
Theorem PbkFromMono_rule : forall a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f1 f2 isId_2 isId_3 isMono_2 isMono_3, vertex a -> vertex a_2 -> vertex a_3 -> vertex d -> edge a a_2 e1 -> a = a_3 -> a_3 = a_2 -> edge a a_3 e2 -> edge a_2 d f1 -> edge a_3 d f2 -> isId e1 isId_2 -> isId e2 isId_3 -> isMono f1 isMono_2 -> isMono f2 isMono_3 -> f1 = f2 -> exists Pullback_2, pullback e1 e2 f2 f1 Pullback_2.
intros a a_2 a_3 d e1 eq_a_a_a eq_a_a_a_2 e2 f1 f2 isId_2 isId_3 isMono_2 isMono_3 eq_f1_f2.
assert (exists Square_2, square e1 e2 f2 f1 Square_2).
  assert (exists Square_3, square e1 e2 f2 f1 Square_3).
  apply Square_rule to a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f2 f1 f Triangle_2 Triangle_3.
  case H5.
  witness Square_3.
  search.
assert (forall x Edge_2 Edge_3 Square_2, vertex x -> edge x a_3 Edge_2 -> edge x a_2 Edge_3 -> square Edge_3 Edge_2 f2 f1 Square_2 -> exists Edge_4 Triangle_2 Triangle_3, edge x a Edge_4 /\ triangle Edge_4 e2 Edge_2 Triangle_2 /\ triangle Edge_4 e1 Edge_3 Triangle_3).
  intros x Edge_2 Edge_3 Square_2.
  assert (exists Edge_5 Triangle_5 Triangle_6, edge x d Edge_5 /\ triangle Edge_3 f1 Edge_6 Triangle_5 /\ triangle Edge_2 f2 Edge_6 Triangle_6).
  apply Square___Def__reverse__rule to x a_2 a_3 d Edge_3 Edge_2 f1 f2 Square_2.
  case H6.
  assert (Edge_2 = Edge_3).
  apply Mono2___Premise__reverse__rule to a d x f1 Edge_2 Edge_3 Edge_5 isMono_2 Triangle_6 Triangle_5.
  case H7.
  witness Edge_2 Triangle_4 Triangle_7.
  split.
  split.
  search.
assert (forall y Edge_2 Edge_3 i j iu xif ju jf, vertex y -> edge y a_3 Edge_2 -> edge y a_2 Edge_3 -> edge y a i -> edge y a j -> triangle i e2 Edge_2 iu -> triangle i e1 Edge_3 xif -> triangle j e2 Edge_2 ju -> triangle j e1 Edge_3 jf -> i = j).
  intros y Edge_2 Edge_3 i j iu xif ju jf.
  assert (Edge_3 = f /\ xif = Triangle_2).
  apply UniqueCompo_rule to y a a_2 i e1 Edge_3 f xif Triangle_2.
  case H8.
  assert (Edge_3 = f_2 /\ jf = Triangle_3).
  apply UniqueCompo_rule to y a a_2 j e1 Edge_3 f_2 jf Triangle_3.
  case H9.
  search.
assert (exists Pullback_3, pullback e1 e2 f2 f1 Pullback_3).
apply Pullback_rule to a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f2 f1 H1 H2 H3.
case H4.
witness Pullback_3.
search.

drawings.name: MonoFromPullback
drawings.rocqProof:
Lemma MonoFromPullback_rule : forall (a a_2 a_3 d : Vertex)(e1 : Edge a a_2)(eq_a_a_a : a = a_3)(eq_a_a_a_2 : a_3 = a_2), ltac:(subst_all_in (forall (e2 : Edge a a_3)(f1 : Edge a_2 d)(f2 : Edge a_3 d)(isId_2 : isId e1)(isId_3 : isId e2)(Pullback_2 : Pullback e1 e2 f2 f1)(eq_f1_f2 : f1 = f2), ltac:(subst_all_in (isMono f1)))).
intros_sigma ().
assert (Hpremise1 : forall (x : Vertex)(f g : Edge x a_2)(h : Edge x d)(fm : Triangle f f1 h)(gm : Triangle g f1 h), f = g). {
  intros_sigma ().
  set (g_2 := g : Edge x a_3).
  set (h_2 := h : Edge x d).
  set (gm_2 := gm : Triangle g_2 f2 h).
  destruct_sigma (@Square_rule x a_2 a_3 d f g_2 f2 f1 h fm gm_2) as Square_2.
  destruct_sigma (@Pullback___Exist__reverse__rule a a_2 a_3 d x e1 e2 f2 f1 g_2 f Pullback_2 Square_2) as Edge_2 Triangle_2 Triangle_3.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule x a a_2 Edge_2 e1 eq_refl isId_2) as f_2 Triangle_4 eq_Edge_f.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule x a a_3 Edge_2 e2 eq_refl isId_3) as f_3 Triangle_5 eq_Edge_f_f.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule x a a_2 Edge_2 e1 f f_2 Triangle_3 Triangle_4) as eq_Edge_f_f_f eq_Triangle_Triangle.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule x a a_3 Edge_2 e2 g_2 f_3 Triangle_2 Triangle_5) as eq_g_g_Edge_f_f_f eq_Triangle_Triangle_2.
  exact eq_refl.
}
destruct_sigma (@Mono2_rule a_2 d f1 Hpremise1) as isMono_3.
exact isMono_3.
Qed.
drawings.abellaProof:
Theorem MonoFromPullback_rule : forall a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f1 f2 isId_2 isId_3 Pullback_2, vertex a -> vertex a_2 -> vertex a_3 -> vertex d -> edge a a_2 e1 -> a = a_3 -> a_3 = a_2 -> edge a a_3 e2 -> edge a_2 d f1 -> edge a_3 d f2 -> isId e1 isId_2 -> isId e2 isId_3 -> pullback e1 e2 f2 f1 Pullback_2 -> f1 = f2 -> exists isMono_2, isMono f1 isMono_2.
intros a a_2 a_3 d e1 eq_a_a_a eq_a_a_a_2 e2 f1 f2 isId_2 isId_3 Pullback_2 eq_f1_f2.
assert (forall x f g h fm gm, vertex x -> edge x a_2 f -> edge x a_2 g -> edge x d h -> triangle f f1 h fm -> triangle g f1 h gm -> f = g).
  intros x f g h fm gm.
  assert (edge x a_3 g).
  search.
  rename H3 to g_2.
  assert (edge x d h).
  search.
  rename H4 to h_2.
  assert (triangle g_2 f2 h gm).

  assert (exists Square_2, square f g_2 f2 f1 Square_2).
  apply Square_rule to x a_2 a_3 d f g_2 f2 f1 h fm gm_2.
  case H6.
  assert (exists Edge_2 Triangle_2 Triangle_3, edge x a Edge_2 /\ triangle Edge_4 e2 g_2 Triangle_2 /\ triangle Edge_4 e1 f Triangle_3).
  apply Pullback___Exist__reverse__rule to a a_2 a_3 d x e1 e2 f2 f1 g_2 f Pullback_2 Square_2.
  case H7.
  assert (f = f_2 /\ Triangle_3 = Triangle_4).

  case H8.
  assert (g_2 = f_3 /\ Triangle_2 = Triangle_5).
  apply UniqueCompo_rule to x a a_3 Edge_2 e2 g_2 f_3 Triangle_2 Triangle_5.
  case H9.

apply Mono2_rule to a_2 d f1 H1.
case H2.
witness isMono_3.
